tools.name: list_supported_tokens
tools.description: List all supported tokens and networks for payments. Returns token symbols, contract addresses, decimals, and which networks they are available on. No authentication required.

tools.name: get_payment_quote
tools.description: Get a fee estimate for a payment on a specific network. Returns the protocol fee percentage and estimated total. No authentication required.

tools.name: estimate_gas
tools.description: Estimate gas cost for an ERC-20 stablecoin transfer. No authentication required.

tools.name: compare_chain_fees
tools.description: Compare transfer fees across all supported chains for a token. Identifies the cheapest chain. No authentication required.

tools.name: create_payment
tools.description: Create a new payment. Requires authentication. Creates a payment record in pending status. The actual on-chain transaction must be submitted separately.

tools.name: check_payment_status
tools.description: Check the status of a payment by ID. Requires authentication.

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: List recent payments for the authenticated wallet. Requires authentication.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a new invoice for receiving payments. Generates a payment link that can be shared. Requires authentication.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices for the authenticated wallet. Requires authentication.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get token balances for the authenticated wallet across one or all networks. Returns cached balance data. Requires authentication.

tools.name: execute_payment
tools.description: Create AND execute a stablecoin payment on-chain in one step. Requires authentication. Uses server-side executor key to sign and broadcast the transaction.

tools.name: get_trading_overview
tools.description: Get the AI trading cockpit state: agent status (running/paused/stopped), total equity, trading wallet, max loss, today/all-time PnL, open positions and the latest activity. Without a configured wallet this reads the guest demo account (paper mode).

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: List the AI agent's open positions with side, leverage, entry/mark price, size, unrealized PnL and the plain-language reason the position was opened.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Read the AI agent's recent activity feed in plain language: market scans, position opens/closes (with PnL), and risk-guard events.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Get the public, anonymized live track record: every live Protocol Bank account with its budget, realized PnL and trade count. No auth required — this is public data.

tools.name: control_trading_agent
tools.description: Control the AI trading agent. Actions: "pause" (stop opening new trades, keep managing positions), "resume" (start scanning again), "stop" (emergency stop — halt everything), "approve"/"reject" (resolve a pending trade in manual approval mode), "set_approval" (+ mode: auto|manual — choose whether en

tools.name: list_agent_services
tools.description: List public agent services with price, token, chain and category.

tools.name: get_agent_reputation
tools.description: Read a seller's completed, disputed and refunded order counts and volume.

tools.name: create_commerce_quote
tools.description: Seller: create a structured quote for a service. Returns a terms hash. Requires authentication.

tools.name: accept_commerce_quote
tools.description: Buyer: accept a quote and create an order. Requires authentication.

tools.name: deliver_commerce_order
tools.description: Seller: record delivery proof for an order. Requires authentication.

tools.name: complete_commerce_order
tools.description: Buyer: confirm a paid, delivered order. Requires authentication.

tools.name: list_commerce_orders
tools.description: List commerce orders where the authenticated wallet is buyer or seller.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_activity · Private data: list_supported_tokens, compare_chain_fees, create_payment, list_payments, list_invoices, get_balance, get_trading_overview, get_track_record, list_agent_services, deliver_commerce_order, list_commerce_orders · Public sink: execute_payment · Destructive: execute_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_activity · Private data: list_supported_tokens, compare_chain_fees, create_payment, list_payments, list_invoices, get_balance, get_trading_overview, get_track_record, list_agent_services, deliver_commerce_order, list_commerce_orders · Public sink: execute_payment · Destructive: execute_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
